title: The Clock
story: A meeting-room clock shows different times on its two faces, one on each side of the glass, and Ivo's scheduling form has lost its spaces and tabs. The engineer tells a tapped Space from a held one, a tapped Tab from a held one, and sees that a modifier pressed first keeps both ordinary.

steps.objective: Separate the times with a tap, then try the held Space and held Tab demonstrations.
Hold a modifier first: Shift + Tab and Shift + Space.
Fill a fresh appointment line without highlights.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Separate two times with a tapped Space, then see what a held Space does in a scratch field (digits, not a space), then tap Space again.
success_criteria: The title field reads standup 0930 (a space between the words, typed with a tap)
In the scratch field the held-Space demonstration shows a digit from the numbers-symbols layer, and the field clears itself
No stray space appears when the demonstration key is released

task.prompt: Scheduling form, line 1 of 1. The clock shows two different times, one on each side of the glass.

steps.expect: a space typed between standup and 0930
rejects: a digit typed instead of a space

feedback.digit: A digit appeared instead of a space: Space was held long enough (about 220 ms) to enter numbers-symbols. Tap Space and let go quickly.

steps.expect: hold Space until the layer shows, tap J: the scratch field shows 7 (observed output only)

feedback.other: Output observed in the scratch field. This page cannot see Space being held; it only sees the 7.

steps.expect: tap Space once more: no digit, a plain space

task.hold_cue: keyboard inset shows Space with a 220 ms ring
task.target_cursor_note: The cursor starts between standup and 0930 so no cursor navigation is needed.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Fill three fields moving with a tapped Tab; then hold Tab once and confirm what happened outside the page.
success_criteria: Name, room and time are filled by tapping Tab between the fields (focus moves in the page)
The player answers the held-Tab confirmation (Homerow opened / nothing opened / skip); any answer continues

task.prompt: Check-in form: name, room, time. Tab moves focus; a clearly announced practice region keeps Tab inside this form and Escape (tap Caps) leaves it.

steps.expect: tap Tab moves focus name to room to time

feedback.other: Tab did not move focus. Tap Tab quickly; holding it for about 250 ms asks Homerow instead.

steps.expect: hold Tab about 250 ms; Kanata sends Shift + Command + Space for the external app Homerow. This page cannot see it.
accepts: confirm: nothing opened or Homerow not installed

feedback.other: Any answer continues. The result is recorded as player-confirmed, never as an observed output.

practice_region.announce: Practice region: Tab stays inside this form. Press Escape (tap Caps) to leave.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Hold a modifier before Space or Tab and see that both stay ordinary: Shift + Tab moves back a field, Shift + Space types a space.
success_criteria: Shift + Tab (Shift held first, then Tab) moves focus back one field
Shift + Space (Shift held first, then Space) types a space, not a number

task.prompt: Same check-in form. The hold on F (Shift) must come first.

steps.expect: focus starts in Room; hold F (Shift), then tap Tab: focus moves back to Name

feedback.Tab: Plain Tab observed: focus moved forward. Hold F first so Shift is down before Tab.

steps.expect: in Note, hold F (Shift), then tap Space: a space is typed after late

feedback.digit: A digit appeared: Space was pressed first and held. Hold F first, then tap Space.

task.os_reserved: modified Space or Tab combinations the OS may take (Command + Space, for example) are explained and shown on the diagram only; they are never required observed outputs

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Correct two appointment lines that are missing spaces and tabs, using tapped Space, tapped Tab, and one Shift + Tab to fix a wrong time.
success_criteria: Both appointments match their targets exactly
The second time field was fixed by going back with Shift + Tab

fields.note: prefilled wrong; focus selects it so typing replaces it

items.fix_with: Shift + Tab from room back to time

task.accepts: field text equals target; Tab and Shift + Tab observed via focus

feedback.other: The field shows the observed output; the target is below it. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Fill a fresh appointment line with no highlighted keys: a two-word title, a time, a room, and one back-step.
success_criteria: The appointment matches the target exactly
The clock hands synchronize and the glass door slides open

items.fix_with: Shift + Tab from room back to time

feedback.other: The field shows the observed output; the target is below it. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: The meeting-room clock disagrees with itself, and my scheduling form lost its spaces and tabs. Can you put them back?

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: To separate the two times, you need to press Space.

hint.action: To separate the two times, you need to press Space.
hint.gesture: tap Space. Tap-hold would enter numbers-symbols.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: To move to the next field, you need to press Tab.

hint.action: To move to the next field, you need to press Tab.
hint.gesture: tap Tab. Tap-hold Tab sends Shift + Command + Space for Homerow.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: To move back a field, you need to press Shift + Tab.

hint.action: To move back a field, you need to press Shift + Tab.
hint.gesture: tap-hold F (Shift) first, then tap Tab. A held modifier keeps Tab ordinary.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: To separate the two times, you need to press Space.

hint.action: To separate the two times, you need to press Space.
hint.gesture: tap Space. Tap-hold would enter numbers-symbols.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: If Homerow opened, tell the form so; if not, tell it that too. Neither answer changes the score.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: The hands agree. Two times, one clock, and my tablet has stopped flashing.
dialogue.cue: Ivo 03: when the clock hands synchronize: pleased

then.text: Orientation 03 complete: the clock room is open.

state_changes.before: The twin clock shows two different times, the clock room's glass door is closed, Ivo's tablet flashes.
state_changes.after: Both faces agree, the glass door has slid aside and the room is walkable, Ivo's tablet is steady.

review_notes: At 1366x768 the form wall (2..4,7) and its approach (3,8) lie in the northwest. With the camera clamped at the map's west edge the avatar sits at screen x 56 and y about 56 at this stop, above the keyboard inset (y from 103), so the form is readable with the inset open. The Tab practice region announces itself and Escape (tap Caps) leaves it.
